note: upstream_ids are this unit's acceptance criteria (AC1.14.x from THIS record, AC5.x and AC6.x from the prior one), its BRx.y from functional-design/rules.md, and every NFRx.y its four nfr-requirements files mention. EVERY declared id is mapped. Seven NFRs are inherited CITATIONS rather than ids D3 defines -- NFR6.21, NFR9.1, NFR14.15, NFR14.27, NFR14.29, NFR20.10, NFR20.11 -- which those files state themselves; they are classified N/A with that reason rather than dropped, so a reader sees why each is present. Statuses are exactly OK, GAP, Deferred and N/A; every target is one workspace-relative path checked to exist; every OK row names a BRx.y from this unit's rules.md; no id was minted. The story map's US5.5, US5.6 and US5.7 correspond to no story in either record, so that work is traced to the criteria that genuinely cover it.
